bio_text: Mark Mi is a growth-focused founder working at the intersection of Web3 and AI, with deep roots in BD, GTM, and ecosystem strategy. He previously served as BD Director - Head of Gaming at NEAR Foundation and holds strong conviction that AI should be user-owned and decentralized, not consolidated under Big Tech. Based in Taiwan, he is also actively running AI upskilling workshops aimed at training 10,000+ people in Taiwan on AI tools.
